blind.description: A stylised bovine carcass lying flat on the ground. It features a horned skull with curved dark horns, an exposed rib cage and spine vertebrae, and residual brown hide or flesh adhering across the middle of the back and fully covering the rounded rump and stubby tail. Surfaces are smooth and continuous with clean stylized forms, without floating pieces, melted anomalies, or extraneous plinths.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears elongated along a diagonal: the rounded brown rump sits at the upper left, transitioning into exposed cream-coloured ribs and vertebrae with a central patch of brown flesh, ending in the horned skull at the lower right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Very low to the ground, about one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 ft tall), with a length of roughly two-thirds the figure's height (around 3.5 to 4 ft long).

notes: bounding box is squarish due to diagonal orientation across the xy plane
